encoding.fieldElement: Canonical BN254 scalar field element as 32-byte big-endian; reject out-of-field values without reduction
encoding.jsonValue: Lowercase 0x-prefixed 64-hex-character string for every public input, including booleans and integers
encoding.order: Declaration order of pub parameters in noir/zkm_revocation_auth/src/main.nr main(); never sort object keys to flatten
encoding.names: Exact registry/Noir snake_case names; reject missing, extra, duplicate or alias members
encoding.booleans: false = 0, true = 1; reject other decoded values
encoding.integers: Unsigned integers are zero-extended into one field element; reject values outside the abiType range
